exposure: maternal history of rhinitis and eczema
cohort: 531 children from Salamanca, Spain, who were part of the International Study of Wheezing in Infants
finding: Different perinatal risk factors were associated with distinct wheezing phenotypes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with transient early wheezing, while exclusive breastfeeding was identified as a protective factor in both transient and persistent early wheezing.
